critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pages/ProviderDashboard.jsx is 702 lines — consider splitting tabs into separate component files for maintainability.

LiveActivityTicker inspection by automation: the inner scrolling row is the 2nd child (firstElementChild was the gradient/badge container) — slight DOM-fragility risk if testers selectorize by firstChild; consider adding data-testid='live-activity-track' on the animated track for robust verification.
ServicesRouteResolver shows a blank screen for ~200ms while probing /api/providers/by-slug — could show a small skeleton/spinner to avoid perceived flash.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing demo provider María (prov_10b9f21bf971) and her cleaned profile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Section 61 (12 bugs) + Section 62 (footer i18n) verified end-to-end on live preview. Provider login is via /login (email+password, then button[type=submit]). For provider profile category, the select sits in the 'perfil' tab of /dashboard/provider as data-testid='form-category-select' (native SELECT). Share URL appears in input at the 'Comparte tu eCard en redes' section below the form. No retest needed.
